versions.changelog: Add API-key setup, configuration verification, and complete scroll workflow guidance; retain live ViralQuery docs as the canonical reference.
Update the skill to the personalized research-brief API and use https://viralquery.com/llms.txt as the canonical reference.

- Updated SKILL.md to reference the official ViralQuery API docs online instead of a local operations file.
- Removed the local references/operations.md file.
- Documentation is now more concise and directs users to https://viralquery.com/docs for technical details.

Initial release of ViralQuery skill.

- Enables finding top viral videos for mobile apps via the ViralQuery protected HTTP API.
- Supports Apple App Store links and app names to look up supported apps and retrieve associated viral videos.
- Allows requesting addition of missing apps (with App Store link) and checking request status (Max accounts only).
- Ensures all results clearly cite source URLs and video IDs as provided.
- Focused on delivering app-specific viral video results with accurate, clearly labeled information.
